summary: The marketing team is juggling multiple high-priority initiatives, with the China Going-Global report and BSI Q2 2026 report nearing finalization, while SEO prioritization for Asia Star and Intelligent China programs is underway, and the knowledge website redesign is awaiting feedback.
summaryDetail: This week, the focus is on finalizing the China Going-Global report and BSI Q2 2026 report, with feedback consolidation and translation reviews due. Simultaneously, the SEO strategy is being refined, prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs, with a draft of target areas and conversion tracking audit in progress. The knowledge website redesign is pending specific feedback from the team, incorporating elements from Joseph's alternative design. Additionally, there are urgent action items for the TIA conference, including finalizing topics and sharing Dean Xiang's presentation details. The team is also managing operational issues like the Outlook account lockout and preparing for the Indonesia emerging markets program launch.

meetings.title: Knowledge Website Redesign Review
meetings.summary: The team reviewed the proposed knowledge website redesign, noting that while the menu categorization is improved, the overall layout remains similar to the current site. They discussed incorporating elements from Joseph's alternative design to showcase more articles and indices, and agreed to provide more specific feedback before finalizing changes.

meetings.title: SEO Strategy and Program Prioritization
meetings.summary: The team discussed prioritizing Asia Star and Intelligent China programs for SEO and marketing, with a focus on improving search visibility for AI, EVs, and smart manufacturing in China. They also reviewed conversion tracking setup and agreed to audit current tracking and prioritize content.
